tree.heading: In general
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out the provisions of this subpart the following amounts:

tree.heading: Availability
tree.text: Any amounts appropriated pursuant to the authority of subsection (a) shall remain available without fiscal year limitation until expended.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 15424 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

ancestors.heading: payments to states and units of local government to assure access for individuals with disabilities
